At the time of his retirement, Mr. Jingo is given a choice between two (10) alternatives:
(i) An annual pension of Tk. 10,000 as long as he lives, and
(ii) A lump sum amount of Tk. 50,000.
If he expects to live for 15 years and the interest/discount rate is 15%, which option appears more attractive?
